verdict.rationale: LangSmith lets you run evaluations during development as experiments on curated or synthetic datasets, separate from live-traffic evaluation (docs-19, docs-7, docs-9, docs-20). That gives a test path that need not touch production. However, nothing in the evidence describes a dedicated sandbox environment or workspace isolated from production. Self-hosting (docs-17) could serve as a separate instance, but the docs do not position it for that purpose. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox/test environment or workspace isolation, explicit separation of test data from production data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
